player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped my reasoning mid-calculation after determining the numerator for the conditional probability, never completing the division to find $P(\text{glimx} \mid \text{zuph})$ or comparing it to the marginal $P(\text{glimx})$. Specifically, I calculated $P(\text{glimx}) = 0.31$ but did not finish calculating $P(\text{glimx} \mid \text{zuph}) = \frac{0.30}{0.96} \approx 0.3125$. Since $0.3125 > 0.31$, the chance is actually larger, not smaller. Next time, I will explicitly calculate the full value of the conditional probability, compare it numerically to the marginal probability, and only then conclude with "Yes" or "No" based on that comparison.
